# pz21 origin scan allowlist (locked at spec_commit; design v4 §1.4, §1.5 item 4).
#
# Paths are relative to the repository root, one per line; `#` starts a comment.
#
# Default section: the only non-test files where `SourceClass::Project` may
# appear in a changed line. Project = rooted project-file reader, own
# build/test command output, Instance-internal assembly (design §1.4).
# Adding a file here is a Spec Writer change, never a Developer edit.

rust/crates/lean-ctx/src/cli/engine_cmd.rs
rust/crates/lean-ctx/src/dashboard/routes/gateway_receipts.rs
# Call sites of the carrier `Project` aliases (`carrier::INSTANCE`,
# `carrier::STORED`); a use of either is checked like the literal.
rust/src/core/context_admission/stored.rs # STORED: store-boundary check; readers re-admit at serve time
rust/src/core/bm25_index/source_gate.rs # STORED: BM25 index write gate, a store write
rust/src/core/import/mod.rs # STORED: imported copy entering a derived store
rust/src/core/contextops/drift.rs # INSTANCE: diff of the user's agent rule files and installed rules
rust/src/core/shell_history.rs # INSTANCE: lines the user typed on this machine
rust/src/core/session/admission.rs # INSTANCE: values of the session's own state
rust/crates/lean-ctx/src/dashboard/routes/memory.rs # INSTANCE: the project's own memory view
rust/crates/lean-ctx-server/src/server/background_shell.rs # INSTANCE: test job fixtures in its mod tests
